Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body:
Name: Rötschreck
[Jyhad:U, CE:U, Anarchs:PG, BH:PTr2, KMW:PB, LoB:PA, Third:PTz]
Cardtype: Master
Master: out-of-turn. Frenzy.
Put this card on a vampire when an opposing minion attempts to inflict aggravated damage on him or her, whether the damage would be successfully inflicted or not. Combat ends. This vampire is locked and sent to torpor. This vampire does not unlock as normal. During this vampire's next unlock phase, burn this card.

A and B is in combat. B play Rötschreck vs A but B be ousted before A unlock phase. So Rötschreck is removed from game. What happen with no unlock effect?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> beslin wrote:
> Name: Rötschreck
> [Jyhad:U, CE:U, Anarchs:PG, BH:PTr2, KMW:PB, LoB:PA, Third:PTz]
> Cardtype: Master
> Master: out-of-turn. Frenzy.
> Put this card on a vampire when an opposing minion attempts to inflict aggravated damage on him or her, whether the damage would be successfully inflicted or not. Combat ends. This vampire is locked and sent to torpor. This vampire does not unlock as normal. During this vampire's next unlock phase, burn this card.
>
> A and B is in combat. B play Rötschreck vs A but B be ousted before A unlock phase. So Rötschreck is removed from game. What happen with no unlock effect?
>
A unlocks as normal since Rötschreck is not in play.
It's different from effects that say "does not unlock as normal during their next unlock phase".
